app.name: EdgeSonic Installer
app.tagline: Deploy your own EdgeSonic instance on Cloudflare, no local tooling required.

welcome.title: Quick deploy EdgeSonic
welcome.subtitle: A public, browser-only deployment flow for getting started without local tooling.
welcome.section1Body: This browser-based deployment wizard ("the installer") helps you create or recover an EdgeSonic instance under your own Cloudflare account. By using it, you confirm you own and are authorized to use the Cloudflare account and API token you enter on the following pages. Every Worker, D1 database, and R2 bucket the installer creates or recovers belongs to your own Cloudflare account, not to the operator of this service.
welcome.section2Item1: Browsers can't call the Cloudflare API directly (CORS), so the installer relays its Cloudflare API requests through a stateless backend we operate. The relay only forwards requests and responses as-is — it does not log or persist your API token, R2 keys, or any request content.
welcome.section2Item2: That relay runs on Cloudflare's own platform. As the infrastructure provider, Cloudflare applies its standard platform-level tracking and anti-abuse measures to traffic crossing its network (e.g. CF-Ray request identifiers, rate limiting, bot detection, WAF rules). This processing happens under Cloudflare's own terms and privacy policy, independently of us — we don't control it and can't make any guarantee on Cloudflare's behalf.
welcome.section2Item3: The Cloudflare credentials you enter live only in this browser tab's session storage and are cleared when the tab closes or the deployment finishes, successfully or not. We never collect, forward to a third party, or retain them long-term in any form.
welcome.section3Item1: The installer creates or recovers the Worker, D1 database, and R2 bucket named on the following pages. An existing Worker is never overwritten without a separate confirmation.
welcome.section3Item2: If the D1 database or R2 bucket name you enter already exists, the installer reuses it instead of failing. You are responsible for confirming those names aren't already in use on your account, so the installer doesn't attach itself to unrelated data.
welcome.section3Item3: "Recover an existing instance" makes a best effort to preserve data, but we cannot guarantee full recovery from damage caused by user error, concurrent deployments, Cloudflare-side failures, or other factors outside our control — keep your own independent backup of anything that matters.
welcome.section4Body: This installer and its relay are provided as-is, with no guarantee of availability, uptime, or continuity. The service may become temporarily or permanently unavailable due to maintenance, changes on Cloudflare's side, anti-abuse measures being triggered, or other reasons, without prior notice — don't treat it as infrastructure you can permanently depend on.
welcome.section5Body: This installer and its relay are entirely free. They exist only to help you deploy your own EdgeSonic instance. We have never charged for this, and never will. If you paid someone for "access" or a "deployment service" to reach this page, you were scammed — please demand a refund and leave them a bad review.

credentials.accountIdHelp: Found on the right sidebar of any Cloudflare dashboard page.
credentials.apiTokenHelp: Use an account-level API Token (cfat_), not a Profile API Token.
credentials.apiTokenStorageNote: After a successful deploy, this token is saved as CF_API_TOKEN on your own Worker's Secrets, for in-app Cloudflare features (permission checks, later updates) to use. It only ever lives in your own Cloudflare account — this installer keeps no copy of it.
credentials.r2KeyHelp: Optional. Add both keys to enable direct R2 presigned playback; leave both empty for normal proxied playback.
credentials.r2KeyInvalid: The R2 keys are invalid or do not have account-level R2 access.
credentials.r2KeysOptionalSkipped: Optional R2 direct-play keys were not provided; deployment can continue.
credentials.r2KeysPairRequired: Provide both R2 key fields or leave both empty.
credentials.tokenInvalid: This token couldn't be validated against account {accountId}. Double-check the token and the account ID.
credentials.r2Enabled: R2 is enabled on this account.
credentials.r2NotEnabled: R2 isn't enabled on this account yet.
credentials.r2EnableLink: Open the R2 dashboard to enable it
credentials.r2GuideStep1: Open the R2 overview page for your account below.
credentials.r2GuideStep2: Follow the dashboard to activate R2; Cloudflare shows any billing requirement before you confirm.
credentials.imagesCardDesc: Lets EdgeSonic resize cover art on demand. Not required — without it, covers are served at original size.
credentials.permissionHint: Cloudflare says this token is missing: {permission}
credentials.genericError: Something went wrong talking to Cloudflare: {message}

target.title: Deployment target
target.subtitle: Names for the Cloudflare resources this install will use. Defaults are fine for most people.
target.workerNameHelp: The name of the Cloudflare Worker running EdgeSonic.
target.dbCollisionWarning: A D1 database named "{name}" already exists on this account. A fresh install reuses it as-is — confirm it's actually empty or belongs to the EdgeSonic instance you mean to recover, not unrelated data, before continuing.
target.bucketNameHelp: R2 bucket name — this is where uploaded music lives.
target.bucketCollisionWarning: An R2 bucket named "{name}" already exists on this account. A fresh install reuses it as-is — confirm it's actually empty or belongs to the EdgeSonic instance you mean to recover, not unrelated data, before continuing.
target.domainHelp: Optional. This wizard can check that the domain's zone is on your account, but binding a custom domain to the Worker currently still needs a manual step in the Cloudflare dashboard after this install finishes — the automated binding endpoint isn't wired up yet.
target.domainZoneNotFound: No zone named {domain} was found on this account. You can still continue and bind it manually later.
target.transformationsOff: Cover transformations are off. Covers still work, but thumbnails use original bytes.
target.transformationsUnavailable: Could not check cover transformations. Add Zone Settings Read to this Account API Token, or check it in Cloudflare.
target.collisionWarning: A Worker named "{name}" already exists on this account.
target.collisionOkOverwrite: An existing Worker named "{name}" was found. Confirm it is the intended EdgeSonic instance before recovery.
target.overwriteConfirm: I verified this existing Worker and its D1/R2 names belong to the EdgeSonic installation I intend to recover.
target.resetAdmin: Reset the superadmin account and issue a new password
target.containerKeep: Keep unchanged — mirror what the Worker already declares
target.containerDeploy: Deploy — declare the container for this Worker
target.containerOff: Don't deploy — leave the container out of this version
target.containerModeHelp: Transcoding runs in a container. Keeping it unchanged is the safe default: a fresh install has none, and a recovery install keeps whatever is there.
target.containerDeployWarning: Declaring the container only succeeds when its image already exists for this Worker. No browser can build one — publish it with wrangler from a machine that has Docker, then deploy again.
target.fullRebuild: Full overwrite — delete the Worker and rebuild it from scratch
target.fullRebuildHelp: Your library is safe: the D1 database and the R2 bucket are kept, along with every setting stored in them. The Worker script, its bindings, secrets, scheduled tasks and static assets are recreated, and the instance identity is carried over. Custom domains are re-attached automatically when possible; upload links already handed out stop working.
target.adminUsernameHelp: Optional. Leave empty to use the default username "admin". Recovery applies it only when superadmin reset is selected. Any username works, including non-Latin scripts.
target.adminUsernameInvalid: Tip: 3-32 letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens is the most portable choice, but this app accepts any username — feel free to continue as-is.
target.adminPasswordHelp: Optional. Leave empty to generate a random password. Recovery applies it only when superadmin reset is selected.
